Ki Dodge: Can spend 1 Ki Point to gain a +4 dodge bonus to Armor Class for 1 rd
Ki Pool: 14 points; refills after 8 hr rest
Ki Strike: When Ki Pool contains at least 1 point, Unarmed Strikes count as magic, cold iron, silver, lawful, and adamantine weapons
Medusa's Wrath: As part of a full-attack action, can make 2 additional unarmed attacks vs. a dazed, flat-footed, paralyzed, staggered, stunned, or unconscious foe
Perfect Strike: May use the best of 2 rolls when attacking w/a kama, nunchaku, quarterstaff, sai, or siangham 20/dy
Power Attack: Can suffer -4 attack to inflict +8 HP, or +12 HP when attacking two-handed
Punishing Kick: Successful kick attack inflicts choice of 5' push or knocked prone (DC 24 negates) 20/dy
Quivering Palm: Can kill a struck foe within 20 days (save Fortitude DC 24 negates) once per day
Scorpion Style: Successful unarmed attack as a standard action also slows the target to 5' for 4 rd (save Fortitude DC 24 negates)
Stunning Fist: Unarmed Strike can inflict stunned for 1 rd, fatigued, sickened for 1 min, staggered for 1d6+1 rd, permanently blind or deafened, or paralyzed for 1d6+1 rd (save Fortitude DC 24 negates) 20 times per day
Touch Of Serenity: May forego attack damage to prevent a foe from attacking or spellcasting for 1 rd (DC 24 Will negates) 20/dy
Two-Weapon Fighting: Reduces the attack penalties when fighting with a weapon in each hand by 2 for the primary hand and 6 for the off hand
Unarmed Strike: Can make an Unarmed Strike when hands are full and adds full Strength modifier to all Unarmed Strike damage
